LEASE_COUNT()
For a message in a queue, returns the number of times the message has been
leased from this instance as a double. Returns NULL for a message that is not in a
queue.
Notice that this counter is set based on leases from the local instance. This counter
is reset when the instance restarts, and does not track leases from other instances.
Parameters
None.
Returns
The number of times the message has been leased.
Available For
Queries of a message queue
Subscription to a message queue
SOW delete by filter for a message queue
